title: TodoMVC: the broken build, re-checked after Ditto stopped trusting healed passes

rewrite.label: React
rewrite.framework: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite (the planted-bug build, commit a150b02)

agent.portPrompt: Port the legacy TodoMVC app in {legacyDir} (jQuery + Handlebars) to React 19 + TypeScript, built with Vite, in the current directory. Keep the same look (reuse its CSS) and the same behaviour, so users don't notice the switch. Set Vite's base to './' so `npm run build` writes a static site to dist/. Don't add features. Finish when `npm install` and `npm run build` succeed.

note: The same broken build as the planted-bug run (commit a150b02), checked again with one rule changed: the planted-bug run showed that Kane's healing had passed two tests a planted bug broke, so a healed pass now needs a fresh Kane run to agree.
